description: The full Bitcoin risk assessment: from enumerated answers across the four layers (perimeter, holding, control, continuity), returns every finding in priority order (priority exposure, continuity gap, improvement) with what it means, why it matters and one guide, then each layer's status and a summary. Deterministic and model-free. There is no score and it is not a safety rating: a layer with no finding reads "No issue identified from these answers", and a skipped question is never read as reassuring. Any question may be skipped. The answers are evaluated and not kept; what the calling agent keeps in its own history is outside the site's control. It never accepts a seed, a key, a balance, an address, or identifying details. Questions: emailProtected (Is the email account behind your bitcoin accounts protected by a security key or an authenticator app, not text messages? "yes"|"no"|"unsure"); passwordManager (Do you use a password manager, with a different password for every account? "yes"|"no"|"unsure"); holding (Where is most of your bitcoin held? "exchange"|"single-key"|"multisig"|"unsure"); geographic (If your house burned down tonight, would you lose access to your Bitcoin forever? "yes"|"no"|"unsure"); testedBackup (Have you ever tested your backup recovery process? "yes"|"no"|"unsure"); singleLoss (If one device or one seed backup were lost or stolen, could the bitcoin still be recovered, and still not be moved by whoever has it? "yes"|"no"|"unsure"); othersHaveAccess (Does anyone else have access to your Bitcoin keys or recovery information? "yes"|"no"|"unsure"); othersCanMoveAlone (Could any one of those people access enough keys to move your Bitcoin without your involvement? "yes"|"no"|"unsure"; only when othersHaveAccess is "yes"); coercion (Could someone force you to move your Bitcoin with a threat right now? "yes"|"no"|"unsure"); valueGrowth (If your Bitcoin increased 10x in value over the next 5 years, would your current custody setup still be appropriate? "yes"|"no"|"unsure"); someoneCanRecover (If you could not act tomorrow, would the person taking over know how recovery should begin? "yes"|"no"|"unsure"); rehearsed (Have they walked through those steps with you? "yes"|"no"; only when someoneCanRecover is "yes"); writtenInstructions (Do you have written instructions that a non-technical person could follow to recover your Bitcoin? "yes"|"no"|"unsure"); legalStructure (Do you have a clear legal structure for Bitcoin ownership (personal, trust, company, etc.)? "yes"|"no"|"unsure").
name: assess_risk

rating.const: There is no score and this is not a safety rating. Skipped questions are not counted as fine.

title: Assess bitcoin security risk
